create_timesformer_config: create a TimesformerConfig instance with default video transformer parameters
build_timesformer_model: build a TimesformerModel from a TimesformerConfig configuration object
configure_attention_type: configure the TimesformerConfig attention_type to space_only, joint_space_time, or divided_space_time
configure_video_params: configure TimesformerConfig with custom image_size, patch_size, num_frames, and num_channels for video input
review_timesformer_config: review the TimesformerConfig class and its PreTrainedConfig inheritance with strict dataclass validation
